result.title: TETRIS-4DGS: Efficient Post-Training Compression of 4D Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has emerged as a powerful dynamic scene representation, supporting real-time high quality rendering but suffers from prohibitive storage overhead. Existing methods typically attempt to solve this by treating compression as a per-scene optimization problem, limiting generalizability and applicability where low-latency compression is required. In this work, we leverage existing image and video codecs and propose a generalized post-training compression framework for 4DGS to address these issues. Specifically, we apply importance-based adaptive quantization to Gaussians according to their importance levels, effectively refining bitrate allocation while remaining fully compatible with existing codecs. To further improve compression efficiency, we utilize the statistical properties of 4DGS and propose motion- and importance-aware packing to reorganize attributes into codec-friendly 2D maps. Our approach can achieve over 40x compression rate in seconds while maintaining high quality, facilitating the practical deployment of 4DGS.

AI.relevance_reason: 该文研究 4D Gaussian Splatting 的后训练压缩（基于重要性的自适应量化与运动/重要性感知打包），属动态场景表示的存储优化，与 LVR/VLM 推理中的 latent 状态生成、视觉证据筛选、停止决策等议题无实质联系，也未提供可借鉴的状态更新或训练监督线索。
